title: A multi-model longitudinal assessment of ChatGPT performance on medical residency examinations

paper.authors: Souto, Fernandes, Silva, Ribeiro, Fernandes (State University of Rio Grande do Norte / USP)
paper.repo_note: Data Availability Statement cites https://github.com/mariaevcsouto/chatgpt-multimodel-medexam-benchmark - returns 404 and the GitHub user has no public repositories (checked 2026-09-04); model answers are 'on request' from mariaevcsouto@gmail.com. Scaffold flag 'data-check' confirmed.

dependence.note: All results are ChatGPT answer accuracies on residency-exam MCQs; the longitudinal claim compares successive ChatGPT web-interface models.

claim.statement: Of 1,041 Brazilian medical-residency MCQs, GPT-4 (ChatGPT web, Sep 2023) answered 81.27% correctly (846; 95% CI 78.89-83.64) and GPT-4o (Jul-Sep 2024) 85.88% (894; 83.76-88.00), p<0.05; on the 92 questions both failed, o1-preview scored 53.26% (42.87-63.65), o3 47.83% (37.42-58.23) and o4-mini-high 35.87% (25.88-45.86), each higher on higher-order than lower-order Bloom items (o4-mini-high 42.31% vs 27.50%, p=0.142) (Abstract; Results 3.1-3.3; Tables 1-3).
claim.metric: accuracy (%) with 95% CI; two-proportion z-tests between models and between Bloom levels
claim.original_source: Abstract; Results 3.1 (accuracy), 3.2 (Bloom), 3.3 (reasoning models on the 92 both-failed items); Table 1 (areas), Tables 2-3 (Bloom by area); Figure 1

protocol.model_note: BLOCKED - every arm was the ChatGPT web interface ('The OpenAI API was not used for this study'). 'GPT-4' (2023-09-06..30) predates GPT-4 Turbo, so the scaffold's gpt-4-turbo match is a false positive from a reference title; 'GPT-4o' (2024-07-29..09-10) is unsnapshotted; o1-preview (dead); 'GPT o3' and 'o4-mini-high' (April 2025) are ChatGPT product names - o4-mini-high corresponds to the API's o4-mini-2025-04-16 with reasoning_effort='high' only as an unverifiable proxy.
protocol.model_status: o4-mini (proxy) dying 2026-10-23; gpt-4-turbo not an arm
protocol.endpoint: none (ChatGPT web UI, one question per message, manual entry); proxy would use the OpenAI Responses/Chat API
protocol.prompt_source: not available - Methods 2.4 says a 'key command' prompt was crafted following the prompt-pattern catalog (White et al. 2023) but does not quote it

params.other: questions in Portuguese; image/table questions and annulled items excluded; session handling not described

protocol.n_items_note: 1,041 for GPT-4/GPT-4o; 92 both-failed items for o1-preview / o3 / o4-mini-high
protocol.evaluation: Manual recording of the alternative chosen by the model vs. the official answer key; Jamovi 2.3.28 for CIs and z-tests

artifacts.data_note: exam questions are public on Brazilian institutions' websites (Portuguese), but the compiled 1,041-item spreadsheet (institution, text, options, key, Bloom label, model answers) is only 'on request'
artifacts.data_license: public exam material; institutional copyright unstated
artifacts.notes: No supplementary data file with the questions in the Frontiers supplement (only figures/tables per text).

blockers: all arms were ChatGPT web-UI product versions - no API snapshot for any arm; 'gpt-4-turbo' is a false positive
the 1,041-question spreadsheet, the 92-item subset and the model answers are unpublished; the cited GitHub repo does not exist
o4-mini-high can only be approximated by o4-mini-2025-04-16 with reasoning_effort='high'
prompt not quoted; session/context handling not described

budget.assumptions: CONDITIONAL proxy run on the 92 both-failed items x 3 seeds with o4-mini (2,000 output tokens/item per the reasoning-model rule; ~450 input tokens). Re-running all 1,041 items with a GPT-4-class proxy would be ~3,123 calls, ~USD 40 at gpt-4-turbo prices.

judgment.rule: ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 (only if unblocked): survival if o4-mini(high) accuracy on the 92-item subset has a Wilson CI overlapping the original [25.9%, 45.9%]; the 'higher-order > lower-order' direction is checked by sign only (original p = 0.142, not significant).
judgment.notes: The 92-item subset is adversarial by construction (failed by both GPT-4 and GPT-4o) and the CIs are +/- 10 pp wide.

user_checks: Request the 1,041-question spreadsheet (with the 92-item subset and Bloom labels) and the prompt from the first author (mariaevcsouto@gmail.com)?
If obtained, accept o4-mini-2025-04-16 (API, reasoning_effort=high) as a proxy for ChatGPT's 'o4-mini-high'?
Is the 92-item reasoning-model claim (35.87%) worth a card at all, given the headline GPT-4/GPT-4o claim has no live arm?
domain_notes: Brazilian residency-entrance MCQs in Portuguese across five areas (internal medicine, surgery, preventive medicine, gynecology/obstetrics, pediatrics); no universal passing score exists (rank-based admission). Bloom classification was done by a single health-education researcher blinded to model answers. Each question was pasted manually into ChatGPT as one message, so results also depend on undocumented session state and the web product's hidden system prompt.
